mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PROCUREMENT_TENDER_DOCUMENT (ID, PROJECT_ID, FILE_NAME, FILE_EXTENSION, CONTENT_TYPE, FILE_SIZE, SHA256, STORAGE_KEY, STATUS, PARSE_METHOD, PARSE_ENGINE, PARSE_CONFIDENCE, PAGE_COUNT, PARSED_CONTENT, PARSE_ERROR, CREATED_BY, CREATED_TIME, UPDATED_TIME) VALUES (#{id}, #{projectId}, #{fileName}, #{fileExtension}, #{contentType}, #{fileSize}, #{sha256}, #{storageKey}, #{status}, #{parseMethod}, #{parseEngine}, #{parseConfidence}, #{pageCount}, #{parsedContentJson}, #{parseError}, #{createdBy}, #{createdTime}, #{updatedTime})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ID, PROJECT_ID, FILE_NAME, FILE_EXTENSION, CONTENT_TYPE, FILE_SIZE, SHA256, STORAGE_KEY, STATUS, PARSE_METHOD, PARSE_ENGINE, PARSE_CONFIDENCE, PAGE_COUNT, PARSED_CONTENT, PARSE_ERROR, CREATED_BY, CREATED_TIME, UPDATED_TIME FROM PROCUREMENT_TENDER_DOCUMENT WHERE PROJECT_ID=#{projectId} ORDER BY CREATED_TIME DESC, ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM PROCUREMENT_TENDER_DOCUMENT WHERE PROJECT_ID=#{projectId} ORDER BY CREATED_TIME DESC, ID DESC) WHERE ROWNUM <= 201

SELECT ID, PROJECT_ID, FILE_NAME, FILE_EXTENSION, CONTENT_TYPE, FILE_SIZE, SHA256, STORAGE_KEY, STATUS, PARSE_METHOD, PARSE_ENGINE, PARSE_CONFIDENCE, PAGE_COUNT, PARSED_CONTENT, PARSE_ERROR, CREATED_BY, CREATED_TIME, UPDATED_TIME FROM PROCUREMENT_TENDER_DOCUMENT WHERE ID=#{id}
